title: Repurchase-versus-debt-paydown decision
prompt:
Choose among debt paydown, share repurchase, and a balanced capital-return alternative.

Begin with the July capital-committee and long-range-plan thread in `Requests/`, including the post-committee clarification. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: identify the current controller-tied workpapers, retain prior versions only for comparison, and resolve source authority from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Several nearby files are earlier working versions or belong to a different reporting purpose. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Recompute the analysis from the shared company sources and do not rely on a deliverable produced by another task.

Tie the repayment ceiling to posted funded debt, calculate after-tax interest savings and foregone cash yield, reduce diluted shares only for actual repurchases, and test cash, leverage, trading-volume, and EPS-accretion guardrails separately. The minimum EPS-accretion gate applies to every alternative; the volume gate applies only to shares actually repurchased. Recommend the feasible alternative with the greatest EPS accretion.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Also optimize a two-year capital-return cadence with annual cash, debt, volume, leverage, share, and EPS gates. The legacy one-period `ending_cash` output means cash immediately after the selected FY27 capital-return actions, before annual earnings effects. Capital-return actions occur at the start of each year. Cap each year's requested paydown at funded debt outstanding at the start of that year; leave any excess requested paydown unspent and do not fail the cadence solely because that request exceeded remaining debt. The supplied free cash flow before returns excludes both the capital-return actions and their after-tax interest-saving and foregone-yield effects, so add those earnings effects to each year's cash roll-forward as well as to net income; `recommended_fy28_ending_cash` is the FY28 year-end balance after those effects.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `recommended_alternative`, `pro_forma_eps`, `eps_accretion`, `pro_forma_gross_leverage`, `ending_cash`, `shares_repurchased`, `debt_paydown_accretion`, `share_repurchase_accretion`, `balanced_accretion`, `feasible_alternatives`, `recommended_two_year_cadence`, `two_year_feasible_cadences`, `recommended_fy27_eps_accretion`, `recommended_fy28_eps_accretion`, `recommended_fy28_ending_cash`, `recommended_fy28_ending_debt`, `recommended_cumulative_shares_repurchased`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
